title: Gowers cube point
statement: Let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, let $y=(y_i)_{i=1}^k$ be a $k$-tuple of points in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $s\in\mathbb{F}_2^k$. The associated cube point is $x+\sum_{i=1}^k s_i y_i$, with addition and scalar multiplication in $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
